provenance.method: Bounded review of current NHS Talking Therapies access information for England; no therapy is selected for an individual.

name: NHS Talking Therapies for anxiety and depression — England
description: NHS route for finding Talking Therapies services in England, including self-referral for eligible adults in participating services.
intended_use: Finding an NHS talking-therapy access route in England without ND Oracle choosing a therapy or diagnosing a mental-health condition.
audience_or_context: Adults in England; age thresholds, local services and suitability vary and the page explains when GP or other specialist routes may be needed.
limitations: This England service must not be presented as a UK-wide self-referral system.
ND Oracle does not choose CBT, counselling, EMDR or another treatment for an individual.
Urgent mental-health needs require urgent-service routes rather than ordinary self-referral.
cost_or_access_notes: NHS service; local availability and waiting times vary.
